result:
The proposed answer is almost certainly wrong. The expected ratio is 1, not r.

The reasoning is by analogy with classical Hida theory. For weight k ≥ 2, the multiplicity of a finite-slope (ordinary-type) eigensystem in the ℘-power level tower is governed by the ℘-stabilized forms. In the Drinfeld setting, the multiplicity of such a λ is constant for r ≥ 1, so it does not grow linearly in r. The proposed "linear growth" claim has no support in the standard finite-slope multiplicity results and conflicts with the control-theorem picture. I have not verified this against a specific reference, so my confidence is moderate.

VERDICT: REJECT
CONFIDENCE: 3
